Installation Instructions

🖥️ Desktop (Chrome/Edge):

  • Look for install icon in address bar (⬇️ or ➕)
  • Or click menu (⋮) → "Install HabitLoop"

📱 Mobile (Android):

  • Tap menu (⋮) → "Add to Home Screen"

🍎 Mobile (iOS):

  • Tap share button (□↗) → "Add to Home Screen"
